notable_absence.finding: Thin, config-field-catalog page as expected - variable table plus one full example payload, minimal prose. Kept concepts/relations minimal rather than forcing ontology out of a reference table.

cross_component_finding: This page is essentially a search-and-replace of slack-reference.md with the message-card format swapped (Adaptive Cards' ColumnSet/FactSet/TextBlock/Action.OpenUrl elements replacing Block Kit's blocks/section/actions/context elements) - the variable table, field names, descriptions, and even the worked example's underlying alert (High CPU Usage Warning, Cluster ABC, us-east-1 AWS, 42s duration) are identical to slack-reference.md's. Strong, direct confirmation that Slack and Microsoft Teams alert integrations share one payload data model end to end, differing only in wire format - the cleanest evidence in this batch for the 'shared model, per-tool rendering' half of the hypothesis.
